# Accessing Elements of 2D Array

#### Course: Learn Java Basics

## Accessing Elements of 2D Array

We have this array from earlier.

```java
int[][] data = {
    {2, 3, 5},
    {7, 14, 21},
    {1, 3, 5}
};
```

Now, to access the element 3, we can use array indexes like this:

```java
data[0][1];
```

Here, 0 represents the position of the inner array (first array), and 1 represents the position of the element inside the inner array (second element).

In this way, we can access other elements of the array.

- data[0][2] is equal to 5
- data[2][1] is equal to 3
- data[1][0] is equal to 7
- ...

![Access 2D array with 3 rows and 3 columns](data:image/png;base64,)

Just like a single-dimensional array, we can also use loops to access array elements.
